name: Meropenem
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Meropenem clearance tracks creatinine clearance (CrCl). The US label reduces the dose or extends the interval when CrCl is 50 mL/min or less; it says information is inadequate for hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis, although meropenem is removed by hemodialysis. In critical illness, prolonged or continuous infusion of the same daily dose may be used per local protocol (label regimens are 30-minute infusions).
kidney_function_basis: Label uses creatinine clearance (CrCl, mL/min; Cockcroft–Gault).

bands.recommendation: Recommended dose every 8 hours (label: CrCl >50; 500 mg for complicated skin infections, 1 g for intra-abdominal infection).
CrCl >50: every 8 hours. CrCl 26–50: recommended dose every 12 hours (label).
CrCl 26–50: full dose every 12 hours. CrCl 10–25: one-half dose every 12 hours (label).
CrCl 10–25: one-half dose every 12 hours. CrCl <10: one-half dose every 24 hours (label).

hd.text: Label: inadequate information. Use the CrCl <10 regimen (one-half the recommended dose every 24 hours, e.g. 500 mg every 24 hours), given after HD on dialysis days; meropenem is readily removed by HD. Specialist input.

pd.text: Inadequate information in label. Specialist input.

crrt.text: Not in label. Published CRRT regimens: 1 g every 8 hours at higher effluent rates (about 35 mL/kg/h); 1 g every 12 hours at lower effluent for susceptible organisms; consider extended infusion; adjust to residual function and MIC (Li 2020).

monitoring: Seizure risk higher in kidney impairment and central nervous system disease; do not combine with valproate (label class warnings).

pediatric.approved_ages: 3 months and older (label). This DUPLEX product is only for children who need the full adult dose.
pediatric.usual_dose: Complicated skin infections 10 mg/kg (max 500 mg) every 8 hours (20 mg/kg if Pseudomonas aeruginosa); intra-abdominal infections 20 mg/kg (max 1 g) every 8 hours; meningitis 40 mg/kg (max 2 g) every 8 hours. Over 50 kg: adult doses (label).

renal.recommendation: No experience in pediatric patients with renal impairment (label). Specialist input.
No experience in pediatric patients with renal impairment (label). Specialist input.
No experience in pediatric patients with renal impairment (label). Specialist input.

pediatric.neonates: Neonates: not established under 3 months in this label; specialist input.
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)
